source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: After the Chaos Terminators shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), [Lethal Obsession](vsdata:ability/emperors-children.chaos-terminators.lethal-obsession) lets you pick an enemy they hit with a ranged attack. For the rest of that turn the Terminators may re-roll their **Charge rolls**. Their **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** must leave that enemy in **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**.
